# SoraTooltip

A short, supplementary description shown on hover and keyboard focus.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | overlays |
| Import | `import { SoraTooltip } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraTooltip from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraTooltip'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/overlays/SoraTooltip.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/overlays/SoraTooltip.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` |  | Supplementary text. Never the only place essential information lives. |
| `placement` | `SoraPlacement` | `'top'` | Preferred position relative to the trigger. It flips when there is no room. |
| `openDelay` | `number` | `500` | Delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds. Keyboard focus shows it immediately. |
| `closeDelay` | `number` | `150` | Grace period before hiding, so the pointer can travel onto the tooltip. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | `props: { describedBy: string }` | The trigger. Bind `describedBy` to `aria-describedby` on the focusable control so the tooltip is announced with it. |
| `content` |  | Tooltip content (replaces `text`). Text only: no interactive elements. |

## Attributes

The wrapper `<span>` around the trigger.

## Keyboard

- Shows on keyboard focus without delay.
- Escape dismisses it without closing a surrounding dialog.

## Accessibility

- `role="tooltip"`; bind the slot's `describedBy` to `aria-describedby` on the focusable control.
- Stays while the trigger is hovered or focused, or the tooltip itself is hovered (WCAG 1.4.13).
- Text only: never put interactive content in a tooltip.

## Styling

- `.sora-tooltip-anchor`, `.sora-tooltip`
- `data-placement`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/OverlaysDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/OverlaysDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
  <SoraTooltip :text="t('demo.tooltip')">
    <template #default="{ describedBy }">
      <SoraButton
        variant="outline"
        color="neutral"
        :aria-describedby="describedBy"
        data-testid="tooltip-trigger"
      >
        {{ t('demo.popover.copy') }}
      </SoraButton>
    </template>
  </SoraTooltip>
  <SoraTooltip :text="t('demo.tooltip')" placement="bottom">
    <template #default="{ describedBy }">
      <SoraIconButton :label="t('demo.more')" :icon="iconMore" :aria-describedby="describedBy" />
    </template>
  </SoraTooltip>
</div>
```
